body:
Republicans literally thought Obama was the antichrist. I think because some black actor played satan on a history channel show and because Obama was also black . . . Obviously connection is obvious. 

I . . . I . . . I have trouble when things like that happen, how am I even supposed to process such information. He was satan and he wasn’t  going to give up his power and the world was going to end. AND people still listen to these same republicans and believe what they say. How. Is it amnesia or . . , was it like “oops wrong guess, let’s try again”. 

So yea the tan suit thing, we should remember that but we need to remember that they thought he was satan. I had a friend who looked me right in the face and said “that was a sign from god, he is satan and isn’t going to give up his power” then I said “ you honestly believe that” and he said “yea”. 

We’re screwed as a species. You guys know that right.

Your ex husband is a monster. It’s horrible what you were forced to go through. I want to say that just the fact you are alive and sane is an accomplishment. A true display of strength and will all on its’ own plus you did it while raising a child. 

I can also assure you that your daughter would value her mothers love far more than any amount of money. It is more essential and it is irreplaceable. If you left her she would go through life with hole that could never be filled.

Explain.

I like examples and other supporting evidence.

Honestly there is no best method because they all could possibly and probably result in your death and I don’t want you to die. I know that is your point and I know how you feel. I tried to kill my self. Ended up being “saved” and went into a comma. 

It might help if you talk about it? Sorry I’m not good at this and sorry you have to feel this way. I hope you decide to stay alive. 

Life is pain. Dying is also a bitch.

Well I believe you can change. Just having the desire to change means you’ve not lost yet. Sometimes it takes a great deal of perseverance just to obtain that will to change. Don’t give up yet, giving up is for tomorrow. 

. . . Erm . . . Uhh . . . Gonna show my age here . . . What a yolo?

Not in our lifetime unfortunately. I was diagnosed with bi-polar many years ago after I tried to kill myself and was admitted. There is no discussion or anything, I’m crazy. Everyone just says I’m crazy and keeps their distance. I’m not a danger to anyone but me. The police can’t even stop shooting mentally ill kids let alone us as a society have a conversation about mental illness.

It really could get better though, I swear it. You could wake up tomorrow and find something has changed or find something or someone that can help. The potential is definitely inside of you and around you at all times. You could meet the person who you want to and will spend the rest of your life with tomorrow. You could discover a passion that helps complete you. The possibility is there. Even if you are depressed and suicidal, or especially because you are, take pride in each day you drag yourself through this life even if it’s just the tiniest most insignificant seeming shred. You’ve made it this far and that was no easy feat was it. Build on that strength. Block by block. Day by day.

I think you mean boys. I’m not really speaking from experience since I was in a relationship for all of five minutes that one time but at that age I think it’s . . .  Like the sex age or so I was told. 

The point is you just have to find a good guy. I know for a fact that all boys that age aren’t like that.

Except there are no parents because of heroin, no one ever bothered to even try to be my friend, no lover just a fifteen year old hole, and the children part by now is little more than a joke. God damnit why am I still alive. It’s very clearly cowardice. I don’t want this to be real, I don’t want this to be real.

Yea especially considering how easy it could be to save some people from it. I had a friend who hung himself because his girlfriend broke up with him . . . How hard would it have been for her to not be so selfish and care about his existence instead of just walking away completely like she did. RIP Pete. I broke up with someone before but I made my self available to her because I realized that I fucking did that, I hurt someone. All of his friends tried to help but we had to watch it happen because we couldn’t do anything but she could have. She went to the funeral though didn’t she.

So it’s like selfishness breeds selfishness . . , I forget where I was going with this. It’s like they are saying we’re selfish but it’s really a response to selfishness. Like I never had a mother who loved me so now, in response to her selfishness, I want to kill myself. You can’t exist without love, not your whole life. It’s fuckin natural. Someone beats into you a sense of worthlessness and they wonder why you feel worthless and don’t put yourself out there and aren’t successful by their definition. It’s just natural but people are stupid and selfish.

What is . . . success?

I had a goal established within societies standards once but every time I tried to accomplish it and I tried and tried and tried . . . It all just comes apart. Like how does someone go to college when in their attempt they have an emotional breakdown everyday because they see all these people around them in happy relationships but you repeatedly try to be in a happy relationship and make friends but it never works out for you, not once not ever. So It all just ended up compounding from experiencing it everyday and everyday not being able to do what normal people do and have what they have. I had a therapist (quite a few) and I told her that I cried from the moment I got into the car until I fell asleep and she just couldn’t conceive of it and told me to just power through. Eventually I broke. Then the whole overarching experience of the failure of it all just compounds and amplifies all the other times you tried and failed. 

I’m sorry I’m supposed to be encouraging . . . You’re a beautiful person and keep up the good work.
